description: Test vectors for the gateway config contract, generated by tests/generators/test_gateway_config_vectors.py: each config is an edit of schemas/platform/examples/gateway_config.local-and-cloud.json, `schema` is what schemas/platform/gateway_config.schema.json decides and `go` is what the Go gateway's reader (orchestrator/internal/gateway) must decide. They differ only where `difference` names an entry of `differences`. Not representable here, and tested by the Go side alone: a key that appears twice or in another case, which the reader refuses and a JSON object cannot hold.

differences.minor: the reader serves any 1.x minor (a later minor only adds optional keys, which it still refuses when unknown); the 1.0 schema names only 1.0
differences.integer: the reader decodes integer fields as Go int: an integer written with a fraction (8192.0) or beyond 64 bits is refused, which JSON Schema counts as an integer; the renderer writes integers without a fraction
differences.owner: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a key's owner is profile:<id> or the key's own alias
differences.deployment-id: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a deployment's id is <role>-<position>
differences.cloud-in-lab: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a cloud deployment needs leaves_lab true on its role
differences.leaves-lab-ceiling: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a role that leaves the lab has a tlp_ceiling of green or clear
differences.embedding-anthropic: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: an embedding role is never served by an anthropic deployment
differences.fallback: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a fallback is another role of the same kind, and an in-lab role does not fall back to one that leaves the lab
differences.max-cost: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a role's max_cost needs its cost_per_1k_tokens
differences.keys-order: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: keys are sorted by alias and each alias is declared once
differences.env-reuse: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: every environment name serves one principal
differences.key-roles: a cross-field rule of the reader the schema cannot state: a key's roles are sorted roles of the config, include every fallback of each, and a local-only key lists none that leaves the lab
